areaNote: Petaling is the loosest match at +3.4% (500.6 km² mapped against a published 484.32 km²). Two honest readings: OSM's mapping of the district edge differs from the official figure, or the published figure predates a boundary revision. It is not a partial ring — that appears as a large deficit, and the relation stitched into one closed ring with the correct bounding box. Accepted under a 5% tolerance fixed before extraction. The other three are +0.1%, +1.7%, +0.5%.
